resources.string: Camera zoom now sits beside the capture button, with the same saved zoom level.
A new control makes celestial objects translucent over the camera. Photos and exports retain the transparency used at capture.
One remembered data-format choice now applies to image, table and scenario exports.
Export filenames follow the chosen language and formats, with hyphens within fields and underscores between them.
The Earth screensaver uses real geographic day and night and the last known real GPS position, also visible on the far side.
Current scenario now shows its resumption policy. Scenario exports have a clearer description and field separation.
